response.justification: The candidate substantially exceeds the 6+ years requirement with nearly two decades of full-stack experience spanning TypeScript/Node.js product work, MongoDB, AWS CDK, Docker/Kubernetes, and recent hands-on AI-agent and MCP tooling development — a rare and explicitly required skill. A strong testing and software craftsmanship culture (TDD, CI/CD, test framework authorship) matches the role's quality focus. Gaps are mostly around specific framework alignment (no explicit Nest.js, Vitest, or Kotlin/Java depth in recent roles), which are learnable given the breadth demonstrated.
strengths: Recent, direct experience building AI-agent infrastructure and MCP code generators
Deep TypeScript/Node.js full-stack background with MongoDB, AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes
Strong testing culture: TDD practitioner, test-framework author, and testing workshop instructor
concerns: No explicit Nest.js or Vitest/Jest/Playwright experience listed
Kotlin exposure absent and Java experience appears dated
Significant portion of past work in niche DLang ecosystem rather than the primary stack
